authority_boundary: This contract owns evidence-depth completeness only. It does not assess medical validity, reinterpret SYS_09 severities, or override System/SYS_09_MEDICAL_RULE_ENGINE.json. Medical adjudication remains with Medical Gate 1 under SYS_09.

status_rules.supported: Requires at least one linked proposition with evidence mapping.
status_rules.partially_supported: Requires the same proposition-to-evidence traceability as supported plus a non-empty support_boundary naming what remains unsupported. A bare partially_supported is invalid.
status_rules.no_evidence_found: Valid non-core outcome. Requires a concise search note and must not be closed by adding an unsupported or invented proposition.
status_rules.not_applicable: Valid non-core outcome. Requires a concise rationale explaining why the dimension does not apply to the approved angle.

core_proposition_invariant.note: This is an evidence floor, not a content-volume floor. Missing, malformed, no-evidence, or not-applicable core_proposition states all resolve to the same terminal human-decision state. No source, claim, word, or runtime count participates in it.

counterevidence_requirement.dimension_level: Records whether the contrary-evidence space for the approved angle was searched and what was found.
counterevidence_requirement.note: A single global counterevidence note cannot satisfy proposition-level requirements.

saturation_requirement.rule: Saturation may be declared only when further searching yields no materially new information for that proposition. No numeric source or claim count floor exists or may be added.
saturation_requirement.anti_fabrication_rule: A proposition added without material support, or added merely to fill an otherwise empty dimension, is a validation failure.

extension_resolution.rule: Applicable extensions are derived by this contract from the artifact's authoritative topic tags. A project may not voluntarily declare or omit its own extension set.

artifact_binding.migration_rule: Phase A validates artifacts only against the current contract version. A dimensions_contract_version mismatch must fail closed and requires explicit Research regeneration or migration before validation; it must never silently reinterpret the artifact under a different contract version.

steps: drop fields classified volatile/non-semantic plus explicitly self-excluded hash fields
normalize all strings to Unicode NFC
serialize UTF-8 with deterministic compact separators and no insignificant whitespace
preserve semantic array order unless schema declares the array set-like
canonicalization.self_excluded_fields_note: research_content_hash is semantic binding metadata, not volatile decoration. It is excluded only because a digest cannot include itself; removing this exclusion breaks deterministic staleness detection.
canonicalization.numeric_rule: Avoid floats in the evidence contract. Where numeric evidence is required, constrain representation explicitly rather than relying on language-specific float serialization.
